title: The state of the buffer desk
summary: On Sep 4, 2026, 87 of 245 buffer ETFs across 3 issuers sat at their cap, so in index terms those funds have no further upside this period.
13 funds had their buffer absorbing losses. The median fund could still gain 5.0% from its current price and could fall 6.3% before its buffer begins, by the issuers' own figures.
Funds resetting soonest carry the least remaining cap, because their index has had the most time to rise toward it; the fresh caps sit in the months that reset last.

tables.title: By reset month, next twelve months
columns: Median index move since period start

method: Issuer-published figures (remaining cap net of fees and downside before buffer, both in fund-price terms) as of the date shown; band states are ETFIQ calculations in index terms from the published terms and the reference return. Medians across funds, not asset-weighted.
